message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep completed for the monitored products in Products.txt, covering the 24-hour window ending with the scheduled run at 2026-06-22 05:10 IST. No high-confidence, newly reported vulnerabilities were confirmed for the monitored product list within this window.

**Findings**

No relevant new vulnerabilities were found in the last 24 hours that met the freshness, product-match, and source-credibility checks.

**Possible matches needing review**

No MongoDB-adjacent, Fortinet/FortiOS, browser, operating system, database, middleware, or application findings were retained as possible matches for this window. Recent candidate items were excluded where the primary advisory date was outside the window, the item was incident or credential-exposure reporting rather than a newly reported vulnerability, or the source did not provide sufficiently fresh primary confirmation.

**Sources checked**

- Mozilla Security Advisory 2026-58 for Firefox ESR 140.12, announced June 16, 2026: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-58/
- Chrome Releases stable desktop security updates in June 2026, including June 8 and June 16 updates: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/06/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0153744567.html and https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/06/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01750511403.html
- BleepingComputer latest security coverage checked for June 20-21, 2026 product-relevant vulnerability disclosures: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/
- CISA alerts and vulnerability bulletin search results checked for fresh items in the same window.

Closing note: No immediate vulnerability-review action is recommended from this run based on the evidence found. Continue normal monitoring for vendor advisories and CVE updates.
